Name: ofds_id
Title: Identifier
Description: An identifier for this node. The identifier must be unique within the scope of the `nodes` array.

Name: phase__id
Title: Phase reference Identifier
Description: The identifier and name of the phase being referenced. Used for cross-referencing. The identifier of the phase being referenced. This must match the `.id` of a phase in the `phases` array.

Name: phase__name
Title: Phase reference Name
Description: The identifier and name of the phase being referenced. Used for cross-referencing. The name of the phase being referenced. This must match the `.name` of the phase in the `phases` array whose `.id` matches the `.id` of this phase reference.

Name: status
Title: Status
Description: The status of this node, from the closed [nodeStatus codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#nodestatus).

Name: address__streetAddress
Title: Address Street address
Description: An address. The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

Name: address__locality
Title: Address Locality
Description: An address. The locality. For example, Mountain View.

Name: address__region
Title: Address Region
Description: An address. The region. For example, CA.

Name: address__postalCode
Title: Address Postal code
Description: An address. The postal code. For example, 94043.

Name: address__country
Title: Address Country
Description: An address. The country in which the address is physically located, from the closed [country codelist](https://open-fibre-data-standard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/codelists.html#country).

Name: accessPoint
Title: Access point
Description: Whether active or passive transmission equipment is installed at this node which is capable of providing access to the network.

Name: power
Title: Power availability
Description: Whether power for active network equipment is available at this node.

Name: physicalInfrastructureProvider__id
Title: Organisation reference Local identifier
Description: The local identifier and name of the organisation being referenced. Used to cross-reference to the `organisations` array. The local identifier of the organisation being referenced. This must match the `.id` of an organisation in the `organisations` array.

Name: physicalInfrastructureProvider__name
Title: Organisation reference Name
Description: The local identifier and name of the organisation being referenced. Used to cross-reference to the `organisations` array. The name of the organisation being referenced. This must match the `.name` of the organisation in the `organisations` array whose `.id` matches the `.id` of this organisation reference.
